intro: Welcome to the first issue. This is the sample issue: it demonstrates the format — every item either carries an exact citation and source link or is marked as unverified, with a verification ledger at the end. Nothing here is legal advice.

CLM-001.summary: No change to the law itself this month — but the statute is the floor everything else stands on, so we re-read it every cycle. Chapter 437 of the Health & Safety Code is what allows you to sell specific homemade foods from home. It sets the allowed-food list, the annual gross-income cap, and the exact statements your labels must carry.

CLM-002.summary: No rule change this month. The DSHS rule (25 TAC § 229.661) is the agency's operating detail under the statute — food-handler training, labeling specifics, and how the sales cap is administered. We re-check it every cycle so you do not have to.
